cases.explain: «Первый жребий» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

cases.explain: «остальных потомков» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

cases.sentence: Семьи ___ были уравнены в правах с семьями младших.
cases.explain: «старших братьев» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
